text.arabic_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًۭا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ

words.prose: {{ar:أَوَ}} ({{tr:a-wa}}) opens the ayah in challenge-mode before any irrigation detail appears. The fused hamza and connector make the coming scene evidence under demand, while the connector also keeps the agricultural sign attached to the prior challenge at 32:26. The opening is later answered by the closing {{ar:أَفَلَا}} ({{tr:a-fa-lā}}), so the water, land, crop, and feeding sequence is framed by twin perception questions.

topics.headline: opening challenge links a new sign to the prior argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the agricultural scene is not neutral description but evidence introduced under a rhetorical demand.
topics.reason: The opening compound is parsed as interrogative plus connector before the negated perception verb, so challenge and linkage both govern the scene.

topics.headline: opening interrogative is answered by the closing interrogative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is ringed by questions, so the middle sequence functions as the proof between them.
topics.reason: The opening challenge and the closing challenge share interrogative force while the final connector turns the accumulated evidence into consequence.

words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) makes the deficiency a failure of perception. It governs {{ar:يَرَوْا۟}} ({{tr:yaraw}}), so the ayah does not deny the water-driving event; it asks why the audience has not recognized it. The past-negating force also carries present-perfect pressure: the sign has been available, and recognition is still being demanded.

topics.headline: negation exposes failed recognition, not failed provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the problem is epistemic: the evidence stands, while recognition is what is missing.
topics.reason: Local syntax makes the particle govern the perception verb, and the rhetorical frame reverses the negative question toward expected admission.

words.prose: {{ar:يَرَوْا۟}} ({{tr:yaraw}}) is visibly governed by {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}): the full indicative ending is gone, so the seeing verb belongs to the opening negation. Its root field makes the requested seeing more than eyesight; the water-to-crop scene asks for considered recognition. The phrase participates in a recurring observable-sign opening and is answered by {{ar:يُبْصِرُونَ}} ({{tr:yubṣirūna}}) at the end, shifting from failed recognition to demanded insight after the evidence has accumulated.

topics.headline: apocopated form shows grammatical subordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening verb is not an independent present statement but a perception act subordinated to the negative question.
topics.reason: The jussive particle governs the verb, and the apocopated surface marks that dependency.

topics.headline: seeing is reflective recognition of visible evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that seeing the agricultural process means reading it as a sign, not merely looking at land and crops.
topics.reason: The local object is a content clause of divine action, so the visual root’s judgment range is locally relevant without becoming a separate abstract sense.

topics.headline: opening seeing joins the closing insight frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 32:27 shifts from the hearing challenge at 32:26 into a seeing challenge and then closes with another perception verb.
topics.reason: The local ayah opens with one perception root and closes with another, while the prior boundary at 32:26 supplies the hearing-to-seeing contrast.

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:ʾannā}}) packages the evidence as a content clause: what they are charged with seeing is that the divine speaker drives the water and brings out the crop. The fused pronoun begins the first-person plural agency chain continued in {{ar:نَسُوقُ}} ({{tr:nasūqu}}) and {{ar:نُخْرِجُ}} ({{tr:nukhriju}}). Because the clause extends through the production and consumption sequence, the whole scene is held together as one perceived proof-unit.

topics.headline: the content clause makes divine agency the object of seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah asks them to see divine agency in the process, not just the process itself.
topics.reason: The subordinator introduces the clause governed by the seeing verb, and the attached pronoun supplies the divine subject inside that perceived content.

topics.headline: first-person plural agency runs through the causal chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one continuous divine speaker across driving water, bringing out crops, and feeding creatures.
topics.reason: The pronoun in the subordinator and the first-person plural verb prefixes form a continuous agency line through the embedded proof.

words.prose: {{ar:نَسُوقُ}} ({{tr:nasūqu}}) is the first active divine verb inside the content clause. It presents water-driving as ongoing and observable, takes {{ar:ٱلْمَآءَ}} ({{tr:al-māʾa}}) as its object, and sends it toward the land through {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ʾilā}}). The root image of driving or herding makes the water a directed provision moved toward need, not merely rain falling in the background; delivery-to-market and limb-support shades stay subordinate but help the movement feel aimed and conducted. This begins the causal chain that {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) will turn into crop emergence.

topics.headline: direct divine driving starts the causal process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign begins with active, ongoing delivery of a moved object to a destination.
topics.reason: The verb is first-person plural imperfect and transitive, with water as object and the land phrase as goal.

topics.headline: driving image makes water an aimed provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices water being driven toward a needy endpoint, while market, limb, and herding branches remain supporting imagery rather than the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports driving and delivery imagery, and the local object-plus-goal frame narrows that range to directed water movement.

words.gloss_range: definite mass water as the driven object and later enabling medium
words.root_gloss_range: water and watery life-medium, with a noted derivational dispute; local sense is the concrete water driven and used for growth
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَآءَ}} ({{tr:al-māʾa}}) is the object being driven, not an independent force moving itself. Its definiteness presents the known life-medium, and its mass-noun shape lets one continuous substance become the means by which crops are brought out; the watery-mixing sense makes that means feel like mediation, not a bare object transfer. The later pronoun in the bundle’s parsed instrument phrase retrieves this water, so the single input runs through the sequence: driven water, emergence by it, crop, then eating. The derivational dispute is specific: the hamzated surface is read against older or alternative water-root analyses, while the local role remains concrete water serving as generative medium.

topics.headline: water is the known object moved by divine action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that water is grammatically acted upon and categorically recognizable as the life-medium in the proof.
topics.reason: Case and attachment make water the direct object of the driving verb, while definiteness gives it categorical force.

topics.headline: water becomes the medium that produces crop output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one water input cascading through land renewal, crop production, and creaturely consumption.
topics.reason: The later instrumental phrase points back to water, and the local collocation with land, emergence, and crop makes water the enabling medium.

topics.headline: derivational dispute marks the water form without changing the local sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surface form carries a derivational history, while the ayah’s syntax keeps ordinary water as the operative sense.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is valid lexical background, but the local accusative object and later instrument role select concrete water.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition marking the receiving land as endpoint
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ʾilā}}) gives the driven water an endpoint. It attaches the water-driving to the land as destination, so the proof is not only that water exists but that provision is aimed at the deprived place. This directional hinge also reverses the same-surah earth theme: 32:10 imagined being lost in the earth, while here water is driven to earth for renewal.

topics.headline: direction makes deprived land the target of provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision aimed at a receiving endpoint rather than water merely accompanying the land.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the land phrase and marks it as the goal of the driving verb.

topics.headline: earth moves from dissolution claim to renewal destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah contrast between earth as imagined dissolution in 32:10 and earth as a renewed destination here.
topics.reason: The row names a concrete same-surah contrast, and the local preposition supports the renewal side by making earth the goal of water-driving.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍi}}) is governed by {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ʾilā}}) and immediately specified by {{ar:ٱلْجُرُزِ}} ({{tr:al-juruz}}). Grammar gives it two pressures at once: it is the destination receiving water and the land whose stripped condition will be reversed. After the result verb, the same land becomes the implied site from which crop output appears, so destination turns into source of visible renewal. Same-surah echoes at 32:4, 32:5, and 32:10 keep this renewal inside the surah’s wider earth frame; unlike the frequent earth-sky pairing, this proof keeps the receiving earth in view without naming the sky-source.

topics.headline: land is both governed destination and bearer of barrenness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that barrenness is not a loose scenic detail but a locked description of the very destination receiving water.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and agrees with the following definite adjective, fixing the phrase as one land-description.

topics.headline: receiving ground becomes productive site
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same land first receives water and then functions as the site from which crops are brought out.
topics.reason: The local sequence routes water to land before the result verb brings out crop, so land shifts from endpoint to implied emergence site.

topics.headline: earth recurrence moves from cosmic frame and dissolution to renewal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this earth is part of the surah’s larger earth-language, with renewal answering earlier cosmic and dissolution frames at 32:4, 32:5, and 32:10.
topics.reason: The row’s sky co-occurrence is background, but the concrete same-surah earth references make the renewal contrast locally useful.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجُرُزِ}} ({{tr:al-juruz}}) is the rare adjective that makes the receiving land visibly stripped. Agreement binds it to {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾarḍi}}), so the ayah is not describing any land but land defined by deprivation. The root’s cut-off image is then reversed by {{ar:زَرْعًۭا}} ({{tr:zarʿan}}): severed surface becomes sown yield. The voracious or hungry shade remains a narrowed pressure, fitting the coming eating clause without replacing the local sense of barren land.

topics.headline: rare adjective fixes the land as stripped and barren
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof depends on a marked barren-land description, not a generic setting.
topics.reason: Agreement and rarity keep the adjective bound to the land’s present condition and intensify the transformation that follows.

topics.headline: cut-off barrenness is reversed into cultivated growth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the lexical reversal from stripped land to cultivated yield, while voracious hunger remains only a pressure toward the eating clause.
topics.reason: The local adjective selects barren land; the cut-off and hungry root associations survive because the next clauses bring emergence and eating.

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the turn from deprivation to production. It makes {{ar:نُخْرِجُ}} ({{tr:nukhriju}}) follow as the result of driving water to barren land, not as a loosely added event. The ayah later repeats consequential force in {{ar:أَفَلَا}} ({{tr:a-fa-lā}}), so one connector marks material result and the later one marks perceptual accountability. A same-surah contrast with 32:20 sharpens the emergence root: denied exit there, divinely produced growth here.

topics.headline: the connector pivots water-driving into crop emergence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that crop emergence is grammatically staged as the consequence of directed water, not as a separate observation.
topics.reason: The connector links the first divine act to the second as result, and its proclitic position attaches the result directly to the emergence verb.

topics.headline: material causation leads toward rhetorical consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah’s result connector is replayed at the closing rebuke, tying natural causation to accountability.
topics.reason: The first connector marks produced crops; the later connector in the closing question marks the consequence that they should perceive, while 32:20 supplies a concrete kh-r-j contrast.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural Form IV causing crops to come out by means of the water
words.root_gloss_range: coming out, extracting, producing, yield, tax/output, and rebellion; local Form IV selects caused emergence of crop from land
words.prose: {{ar:نُخْرِجُ}} ({{tr:nukhriju}}) keeps the same divine speaker active while changing the action from driving to causing emergence. Form IV makes the crop’s appearance a caused act, and the following instrument phrase ties that emergence to the water already driven. The root’s broader output field helps the crop feel like land-yield drawn out, while rebellion or tax branches stay outside the local sense. Same-surah 32:20 contrasts blocked exit with this free divine bringing-forth.

topics.headline: Form IV assigns crop emergence to divine causation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that crops are not merely said to emerge; the form makes their emergence a divine caused act.
topics.reason: The first-person plural imperfect matches the earlier divine verb, and Form IV encodes caused emergence with crop as object.

topics.headline: emergence is mediated by water and focused on land-yield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices crop as output drawn from land by water, while other root branches such as rebellion remain inactive locally.
topics.reason: The instrument phrase and crop object narrow the broad kh-r-j field to produced land-output through water.

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) keeps the earlier water active without repeating the noun. In the bundle’s local parse, the preposition carries a pronoun resolved to the water and attaches to {{ar:نُخْرِجُ}} ({{tr:nukhriju}}), so the crop is brought out by means of it. The phrase stands between act and product, making the mechanism of provision visible before {{ar:زَرْعًۭا}} ({{tr:zarʿan}}) is named.

topics.headline: water remains active as the means of crop emergence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that water does not disappear after being driven; it becomes the instrument through which crops emerge.
topics.reason: The local attachment resolves the prepositional pronoun to water and assigns it an instrumental role with the emergence verb.

words.prose: {{ar:زَرْعًۭا}} ({{tr:zarʿan}}) names the product brought out by the causative verb. Its indefinite tanwīn leaves the crop type open, so the result is cultivated yield as a category rather than one specified plant. Lexically it answers {{ar:ٱلْجُرُزِ}} ({{tr:al-juruz}}): stripped land becomes sown growth. The crop then becomes the source from which livestock and selves eat, carrying the output into beneficiaries; the growth-emergence motif also recalls cultivation putting forth growth in 48:29.

topics.headline: indefinite crop names generalized output
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the result is open-ended cultivated yield, not one named crop variety.
topics.reason: Case makes the noun the produced object, and indefiniteness makes the output general.

topics.headline: sown growth reverses stripped land and feeds beneficiaries
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices crop as the lexical reversal of barren land and as the transfer medium into animal and human eating.
topics.reason: The local sequence brings crop out after the barren-land phrase, then describes eating from it; the cross-reference to 48:29 supports a concrete growth-emergence motif.

words.gloss_range: ongoing eating clause that transfers produced crop to livestock and human selves
words.root_gloss_range: eating, consuming, absorbing, produce, wealth-consumption, and corrosion; local Form I selects ordinary sustenance from crop-source
words.prose: {{ar:تَأْكُلُ}} ({{tr:taʾkulu}}) turns output into intake. The imperfect presents ongoing feeding, and the feminine singular form fits the collective livestock subject in the base local parse. Its root field makes the crop consumable provision, but the form stays ordinary Form I eating rather than an intensive devouring pattern. A variant with masculine singular exposes the possible hover between crops absorbing from water and livestock eating from crops, yet the attachment evidence keeps the canonical reading focused on livestock and selves eating from the crop-source.

topics.headline: the crop becomes ongoing sustenance for named beneficiaries
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from produced crop to repeated creaturely benefit.
topics.reason: The verb describes the crop, takes a source phrase, and agrees with the collective livestock subject in the local parse.

topics.headline: eating means assimilated sustenance, with variant role pressure kept bounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the crop becoming internal benefit, while broader consumption branches and the masculine variant do not displace the canonical beneficiary reading.
topics.reason: The root range supports consumption and produce, but local syntax selects ordinary eating from the crop; the variant is useful contrast rather than governing parse.

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) points the eating back to the crop-source before the consumers are named. In the bundle’s parsed phrase, the pronoun retrieves {{ar:زَرْعًۭا}} ({{tr:zarʿan}}); the preposition can mark source and partitive portion together. That keeps the feeding relation compressed: they eat from it, without inventing a separate object beyond the crop-source.

topics.headline: the preposition makes crop the source eaten from
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the crop is not merely produced; it becomes the source from which consumption proceeds.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase attaches to the eating verb and retrieves the crop, preserving both source and possible partitive force.

words.prose: {{ar:أَنْعَٰمُهُمْ}} ({{tr:anʿāmuhum}}) names the first eating beneficiaries as their livestock. The suffix binds the animals to the challenged group, so the evidence reaches their own herd-system. The noun’s blessing field becomes concrete: animals are not abstract favor but sustained creatures and property. Because livestock are named before {{ar:أَنفُسُهُمْ}} ({{tr:anfusuhum}}), the clause resists a human-first hierarchy and places human eating inside a broader dependency chain.

topics.headline: their own livestock benefit from the sign they fail to read
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof reaches the audience through their own dependent animals, not only through scenery.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix makes the livestock definite by relation to the challenged plural audience while preserving referent ambiguity.

topics.headline: livestock are the first coordinated eating subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices animals named first as a collective consuming class before human selves are added.
topics.reason: Local agreement and word order make livestock the first overt subject of the eating verb, with human selves coordinated afterward.

topics.headline: the blessing field becomes embodied animal sustenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices livestock as concrete blessing and comfort sustained by the crop, not just a possession label.
topics.reason: The root family links blessing and livestock, and the local eating clause materializes that lexical field as daily animal sustenance.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating human selves with livestock under one eating action
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds human selves without starting a new verb. The conjunction keeps livestock and people distinct, but it places both under the same eating relation from the same crop-source. That small hinge matters because it makes human benefit share the animal-feeding system rather than rise into a separate, elevated clause; it also prepares the same-surah contrast with the self that does not know the hidden reward in 32:17.

topics.headline: one conjunction keeps two consumers distinct but joined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that animals and human selves share one provision relation while remaining two distinct beneficiary groups.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second noun with the first subject of the eating verb, preventing apposition and avoiding a repeated verb.

topics.headline: coordination opens a same-surah self contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a move from the unknown soul in 32:17 to embodied selves fed by crop here.
topics.reason: The conjunction is the local point where the human self noun enters the consumption chain, making the concrete same-surah echo relevant.

words.gloss_range: possessed human selves as embodied beneficiaries immediately before the perception demand
words.root_gloss_range: self, person, soul, breath, appetite, life, and embodied need; local plural selects their own persons as consumers
words.prose: {{ar:أَنفُسُهُمْ}} ({{tr:anfusuhum}}) brings the proof into their own persons. The possessive suffix binds the selves to the challenged group, and the broken plural distributes the benefit across individual persons while keeping them together under one possessive relation. Because these selves share the same eating verb as livestock, human need is located inside the same provision chain. Immediately afterward the ayah asks whether they perceive, so the bodies being sustained become the agents responsible for insight; 32:17’s hidden reward frame is answered here by embodied consumption.

topics.headline: their own selves are fed, collectively and personally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof reaches the audience’s own persons, not only their animals or surroundings.
topics.reason: The plural noun with possessive suffix binds individual selves to the challenged group while preserving the unresolved audience reference.

topics.headline: fed selves become responsible perceivers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demand to perceive is addressed to embodied beings already sustained by the sign.
topics.reason: The self/breath/appetite range fits the local eating context and the following perception demand, joining bodily need to accountability.

topics.headline: human selves follow livestock within the same dependency chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices humans listed after animals and linked to the same-surah movement from soul/knowledge language to material dependence at 32:17.
topics.reason: Word order places selves after livestock, and the concrete 32:17 echo supports the move from hidden knowledge to embodied provision.

words.prose: {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:a-fa}}) begins the closing challenge. The hamza asks, while the consequential connector makes the question follow from the whole provision chain: water driven, crop brought out, livestock and selves fed. It mirrors the opening {{ar:أَوَ}} ({{tr:a-wa}}) but changes the connector to consequence, so the ayah lands as a reasoned rebuke. Across the boundary from 32:26 to 32:27, the repeated challenge formula shifts from hearing to seeing.

topics.headline: question plus consequence turns provision into accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final question is not a request for information but the consequence demanded by the sign.
topics.reason: The compound combines interrogative and consequential force before the negator and final perception verb.

topics.headline: closing challenge mirrors the opening and pairs with 32:26
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah’s opening and closing question-frame, plus the adjacent shift from hearing in 32:26 to seeing in 32:27.
topics.reason: The final interrogative mirrors the first while the repeated formula across 32:26 and 32:27 changes the demanded faculty.

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives the closing question its polarity. Unlike the opening {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}), it negates the imperfect perception verb as present or habitual non-seeing. Inside {{ar:أَفَلَا}} ({{tr:a-fa-lā}}), the literal negation becomes a rebuke that expects the opposite: after this evidence, they should perceive. Its separate word-form keeps the challenge visibly negative rather than turning the ending into a simple command to see.

topics.headline: negative question rebukes ongoing failure to perceive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from earlier failure to see toward a present responsibility to perceive now.
topics.reason: The negator scopes over the final imperfect verb inside a rhetorical question, preserving both literal negation and expected affirmation.

words.prose: {{ar:يُبْصِرُونَ}} ({{tr:yubṣirūna}}) is the ayah’s last word, so the chain ends not with food but with perception. It remains indicative after {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) and has no explicit object, widening the demand to the whole preceding proof rather than one item. The root field asks for sight that recognizes evidence, though broader expertise language stays a supporting pressure. The canonical third-person plural keeps the rebuke about them, while the accepted {{ar:تُبْصِرُونَ}} ({{tr:tubṣirūna}}) variant shows how direct-address pressure can enter recitation. Together with opening {{ar:يَرَوْا۟}} ({{tr:yaraw}}), the embodied selves just fed, and the hearing challenge at 32:26, the final verb seals a perception architecture in which ruins are to be heard and agricultural provision is to be seen.

topics.headline: the last word demands perception of the whole chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on required perception, with no object limiting that perception to a single item.
topics.reason: The final verb is negated in the rhetorical question and lacks an overt object, so the preceding provision chain supplies its scope.

topics.headline: sight becomes evidence-recognition, not mere optics

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from driving water to crop emergence and consumption by livestock and human selves.
baseline_models.mechanism: A directed input reaches a depleted receiver, becomes the instrument of emergence, and yields food to two classes of living consumers. Destination, consequence, and instrument marking make this a managed supply chain rather than an undifferentiated rain scene.

activation_trace.role: The driving and herding motion supplies deliberate transport rather than passive arrival.
The irrigation and pouring sense supplies delivery of water into a receiving site.
The vegetation-stripped terrain supplies the depleted initial state of the receiver.
Emergence from concealment supplies the conversion of inaccessible growth into visible yield.
Cultivated growth supplies the productive middle stage between water and food.
The edible share and sustenance sense makes the crop a distributed provision rather than scenery.
The livestock sense identifies the first named beneficiaries within the supply chain.
The living-self sense identifies human life as another dependent beneficiary.

changed_reading.before: A familiar report that rain makes crops grow.
changed_reading.after: A staged provisioning mechanism in which directed transport, a depleted destination, mediated emergence, and shared consumption are all made inspectable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of cut-off land, brought-out cultivation, and subsequent eating.
baseline_models.mechanism: The land begins under images of cutting and exhaustive consumption, then the sequence reverses that subtraction by bringing out new growth. Eating returns at the end in a bounded, life-sustaining form, creating a cycle from depletion through replenishment to legitimate consumption.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and removal supply the prior subtraction encoded in the land's condition.
Exhaustive eating supplies a latent image of the field as already consumed.
Movement to the outside supplies the reversal from absence to available growth.
Plant development supplies replenishment after the field's depleted state.
Literal eating supplies the endpoint that sustains creatures without repeating total depletion in the wording.

changed_reading.before: The barren adjective merely describes a difficult agricultural location.
changed_reading.after: The field carries a history of subtraction that is actively reversed, so the verse pictures restoration of a consumed system rather than growth on a neutral surface.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verse is bracketed by an opening challenge about seeing and a closing challenge about sight.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening faculty can register the visible sequence and also deliberate over it; the closing faculty can likewise remain ocular or become inward discernment. The repeated challenge therefore forms a ladder from witnessed process to understood significance.

activation_trace.role: Sensory and inward seeing supplies direct access to the displayed process.
Reflective judgment supplies the cognitive work expected from what is seen.
Ocular sight closes the frame by returning attention to the observable field.
Penetrating inward knowledge supplies the unrealized conclusion of the visual demonstration.

changed_reading.before: The two perception questions are emphatic repetition.
changed_reading.after: They stage a failed transition from registering a recurrent event to extracting knowledge from its causal order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Livestock are named before human selves as eaters from the same crop.
baseline_models.mechanism: One water-mediated yield crosses species and sustains both animal wealth and living persons. Naming animals first resists a purely human-centered reading and exposes a shared ecology of dependence.

activation_trace.role: Supplied water provides the common material input for both classes of consumer.
Edible provision supplies the common relation linking crop, animals, and humans.
Herd animals supply a nonhuman consumer whose welfare enters the verse before human welfare.
The sense of water that keeps life going tightens the dependency between the input and living selves.
The life-bearing self supplies the human consumer as organism rather than abstract observer.

changed_reading.before: The animals are an incidental addition to a human provision scene.
changed_reading.after: Animals and people are co-dependents in one trophic circuit, and the ordering briefly decenters human consumption.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier descent, nurturing completion, and outcome-aware management align on a heaven-to-earth axis. They strengthen the focus verse's water-driving as a concrete, recurring instance of ordered delivery into the lower world.

activation_trace.role: Directed driving supplies the local transport mechanism that context expands into governance.
Irrigation supplies the delivered substance and its practical destination.
Caused descent and delivery supply an earlier template of something intentionally conveyed downward.
Nurturing, repair, and completion supply the functional aim of the water route.
Planning with regard to outcomes supplies the controlling logic behind the ordered stages.
The overarching sky supplies the upper endpoint of the contextual vertical corridor.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the same destination later occupied by the dry field.

structural_cues: 32:5 places management before a heaven-to-earth trajectory that matches the focus verse's destination frame.
The focus verse orders destination, consequence, instrument, and beneficiaries rather than merely naming rain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies downward delivery, nurturing completion, management of outcomes, and a sky-to-earth axis; I infer that the water route is a visible instance of that governance. A live alternative is that the two routes are parallel examples without a tighter identification.

changed_reading.before: The water is purposefully moved within a local agricultural event.
changed_reading.after: The local event becomes the ground-level leg of a larger administered descent whose success is measured in completed nurture.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch of gratitude names the emergence of tender shoots. Against the earlier complaint of little gratitude, the focus field visibly manifests what it receives, while its human consumers receive the yield without making the corresponding response visible.

activation_trace.role: The sprouting of fresh growth gives gratitude a material image of received benefit becoming outwardly manifest.
Brought-out hidden growth supplies the field's visible response to the supplied water.
Developing plants embody increase made visible after reception.
Consumed provision locates humans and animals on the receiving side of the comparison.

structural_cues: 32:9 places granted faculties immediately before the charge of scant gratitude.
32:27 places supplied water before visible yield and then names the consumers of that yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gratitude branch involving new shoots and a field that produces shoots after receiving water; I analogize productive manifestation to grateful response. The live alternative is that this is only a lexical image and that the field should not be personified as responsive.

changed_reading.before: The crop is evidence of power and a source of food.
changed_reading.after: The crop also models benefit made manifest, sharpening the contrast between the earth's yield and the consumers' failure to manifest gratitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: The objection about disappearing in earth and becoming a new creation is answered materially by the focus sequence: a surface marked by loss receives water and releases living form. The field does not prove every detail of return, but it makes re-emergence after terrestrial disappearance experientially available.

activation_trace.role: Vegetation-stripped earth supplies an observable state resembling material loss.
Caused disclosure from concealment supplies the central re-emergence operation.
Living selves supply the human life whose return is at issue in the contextual objection.
Disappearance from view supplies the feared loss of bodily material.
The lower terrestrial realm supplies the shared material location of disappearance and renewed growth.
Origination of created form supplies the operation doubted by the speakers.
Renewed occurrence after a break supplies the discontinuity bridged by new creation.
Return to a prior destination supplies the larger trajectory into which the field's re-emergence is read.

structural_cues: 32:10 places disappearance in earth directly beside the question of new creation.
The focus verse stages a depleted earth, an arriving material input, and caused emergence in that order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies terrestrial disappearance, renewed creation, return, and observable emergence from depleted land; I infer a process analogy between vegetation and bodily return. A live alternative is a looser argument from originating power rather than a mapped model of reassembly.

changed_reading.before: The field demonstrates restoration after ecological depletion.
changed_reading.after: It also becomes a small material rehearsal of return after disappearance in earth, answering an earlier impossibility claim through a recurrent process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Perception is first granted, then weakly answered with gratitude; later the speakers claim sight and certainty only after confrontation, while turning away and denied delay close the opportunity. The focus demand to see the field is therefore not neutral cognition but timely use of a faculty before recognition loses practical effect.

activation_trace.role: Present seeing supplies immediate access to evidence while response remains possible.
Inward discernment supplies the response demanded now rather than later.
The granted capacity for inward knowledge establishes perception as an entrusted faculty.
Recognition of benefit and its giver supplies the expected consequence of perception.
The later sight scene supplies the moment when formerly resisted evidence becomes unavoidable.
The speakers' eventual discernment supplies recognition that arrives after the useful interval.
Settled knowledge without doubt supplies the endpoint that still fails to restore the lost opportunity.
Turning one's side away supplies the active refusal that can interrupt the path from sight to insight.
Waiting and granted respite supply the temporal resource explicitly unavailable at the final opening.

structural_cues: 32:12 converts the focus verse's present challenge into a later first-person claim of seeing and certainty.
32:22 names turning away after reminder, and 32:29 removes further waiting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies granted perception, scant gratitude, delayed certainty, active turning, and denied respite; I infer that the focus's visible field is an opportunity with a deadline. A live alternative is that these are separate rebukes without a single temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The perceptual frame asks observers to understand the agricultural process.
changed_reading.after: It asks them to convert available sight into response now, before later certainty becomes cognitively complete but practically ineffective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus chain ends in nourishment, but the earlier faithful pattern sends received provision outward through expenditure. Taken together, water, crop, eating, and spending form a circulation in which reception sustains agents who can become distributors rather than terminal consumers.

activation_trace.role: Delivered irrigation supplies the incoming material flow at the start of the circuit.
Plant increase converts the incoming flow into transferable nourishment.
Sustaining shares supply the reception stage of the social and ecological circuit.
Rain descending as provision directly joins the earlier gift language to the focus water route.
Food that sustains supplies the conversion from natural yield to maintained life.
The outward movement of wealth supplies a human outflow after divine provision is received.

structural_cues: 32:16 explicitly makes spending proceed from what was provided.
32:27 explicitly makes eating proceed from what water brings forth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies incoming provision, nourishment, and outgoing expenditure; I infer that nourishment enables recipients to re-enter a distributive flow. A live alternative is that the focus ends at consumption and only illustrates the source of provision without implying a social continuation.

changed_reading.before: Shared eating is the terminal benefit of the water-and-crop sequence.
changed_reading.after: Eating becomes one receiving stage in a wider circulation whose faithful human continuation is outward expenditure from what was received.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same emergence root succeeds under divine causation in the focus but fails as attempted self-exit from fire, where the agents are returned. The contrast activates a threshold model: emergence is not automatic; agency and authorization determine whether a boundary opens or closes.

activation_trace.role: Successful movement outward supplies the focus scene's opened threshold.
Divinely caused disclosure supplies the controlling agency behind the crop's emergence.
Attempted movement outward supplies the matching operation that is denied in the punitive scene.
Burning fire supplies the enclosing domain from which attempted exit is reversed.
Return after departure supplies the reversal that cancels the attempted exit.

structural_cues: 32:20 uses creaturely attempted exit followed by passive return.
32:27 uses divine causation and an instrumental medium to produce successful emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same outward motion with opposite outcomes and different agency; I infer a controlled-threshold rule in which authorized emergence succeeds. A live alternative is that the grammatical contrast intensifies divine power without establishing a general threshold mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Crop emergence is simply the successful middle stage of irrigation.
changed_reading.after: It is a granted opening of a closed material boundary, pointedly contrasted with an exit that creatures cannot secure for themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hoped-for moral return after a nearer corrective experience activates a branch in which return is specifically returning rain or water. The focus then materializes recoverability: water comes back to a cut-off field and productive life resumes.

activation_trace.role: Water delivered to a receiver supplies the restorative material whose return can change the field.
Rain-cut and vegetation-cut terrain supplies the damaged state that remains recoverable.
Renewed plant growth supplies the visible effect of successful return.
Experienced trial supplies the corrective pressure placed before the hoped-for return.
Nearness supplies the limited and proximate character of the corrective event.
Returning rain or water supplies the ecological image that connects moral return to restored productivity.

structural_cues: 32:21 places a desired return after a nearer corrective experience.
The focus verse places productive emergence after water reaches land marked by loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hoped-for return, a branch of returning water, and a field restored by water; I infer an analogy between moral and ecological recoverability. The live alternative is that the water sense is only branch resonance and the verse offers no repentance metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The returning productivity of the field demonstrates natural restoration.
changed_reading.after: It can also image the possibility of corrective return: depletion is serious, but renewed input can still reopen growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent prior verse presents destroyed generations encountered through inherited dwellings and closes with hearing or heeding; the focus presents recurring water and crop and closes with seeing or insight. Together they form complementary evidence channels, historical trace and ecological recurrence.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a path or truth supplies the pedagogical function of the historical evidence.
Collapse into destruction supplies the absent populations whose traces remain.
Bodily movement supplies present passage through spaces left by the destroyed generations.
Former habitation supplies the durable spatial trace through which past lives are encountered.
An evident marker supplies the sign-status shared by ruins and the irrigated field.
Understanding and compliance supply the response requested from historical testimony.
Visible apprehension supplies the faculty suited to the recurrent ecological demonstration.
Inward sight supplies the understanding expected from the second evidence channel.

structural_cues: 32:26 and 32:27 use matching opening challenges and closing faculty questions.
The first scene concerns prior peoples whose dwellings remain; the second concerns a process observers can watch recur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched rhetoric, historical remains, hearing, a visible ecological process, and sight; I infer a deliberate pairing of testimony with observation. A live alternative is that hearing means heeding in both domains, so the media distinction is less sharp than the rhetorical pairing.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a self-contained natural sign.
changed_reading.after: It is the visual second panel of a paired lesson: inherited history is to be heard and heeded, while recurrent restoration is to be watched and understood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verses immediately after the focus ask about an opening and state that the final opening brings neither benefit nor delay. Branches of opening name both water issuing from an outlet and release of inward blockage, so the present field can be carried as an earlier double opening of matter and insight while response still benefits.

activation_trace.role: Water delivered into the field supplies the material that can open a closed productive system.
Disclosure from concealment supplies the field's material opening.
Inward discernment supplies the cognitive opening requested before the final event.
Water bursting from an outlet supplies a direct material bridge from the asked-about opening to the field.
Release of inward closure supplies the insight that the focus question seeks to produce.
Decisive judgment that breaks closure supplies the final opening against which the present one is timed.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the practical value available before but not at the final opening.
Waiting and respite supply the extension explicitly denied after the decisive opening.

structural_cues: The question about opening follows immediately after the focus's demand for sight.
The next verse joins the final opening to loss of benefit and loss of waiting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent opening language, branches of water release and insight, and a final state without benefit or delay; I infer that the field is an anticipatory opening available in useful time. The live alternative is that the agricultural opening is only an analogy and does not qualify the contextual event's judicial sense.

changed_reading.before: The field is present evidence for a future claim.
changed_reading.after: It is also a merciful opening already occurring in matter and potentially in perception, before the final opening makes new recognition useless.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because reproductive branches are not the surface agricultural senses, and the womb branch at 32:6 is activated from a mercy expression. It remains worth carrying because visibility of pregnancy, generative water, sterility, sowing as semen, birth, and the explicit lineage-from-water sequence converge on several focus anchors. Render it only as a cross-domain gestational analogy, not as a claim that the field words lexically denote a womb or pregnancy here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Water enters land marked by sterility, growth is brought out, and animals and living selves are sustained.

activation_trace.role: Pregnancy becoming outwardly visible lets the opening sight-word frame a transition from hidden generation to manifest life.
Generative fluid entering a womb supplies the reproductive analogue for water entering receptive land.
Dryness and sterility supply the initially nonproductive condition that generation reverses.
Human seed figured as sowing supplies the bridge between agricultural and reproductive generation.
Birth and the emergence of a child supply the terminal transition from hidden formation to independent life.
The maternal organ supplies the containing space in the cross-domain model.
Continuing offspring supplies the explicit human-generational outcome.
An extracted generative essence supplies the concentrated beginning of lineage.
Reproductive water explicitly joins human lineage to the focus verse's water-mediated generation.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts irrigation overcoming agricultural barrenness.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the same stages can be carried as a gestational pattern in which generative fluid enters a sterile matrix, hidden formation becomes visible life, and the resulting life sustains further lives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a non-dominant mapped target of the opening sight root and crosses from textual communication to hydrology. It remains anchored in the focus's seeing frame, driven water, emergent visible result, and closing insight, while the context supplies downward delivery, writing, guidance, and signs. Render it as a formal analogy between two delivered and readable processes, never as an assertion that revelation and rain are identical referents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verse asks observers to read a directed water-to-growth process through sight and insight.

activation_trace.role: Carrying and supplying water lets the opening perception root echo the material action it introduces.
A rain-heavy cloud supplies a weather image latent in the same non-dominant mapped target.
Directed conveyance supplies the delivery operation shared by the analogy.
Inward understanding supplies the act of reading significance from the delivered process.
Intentional downward delivery supplies the structural counterpart to routed water.
Ordered written signs supply the communicative object on one side of the analogy.
Gentle indication toward truth supplies the intended cognitive yield of delivered communication.
A manifest marker supplies the category under which the visible field can become readable evidence.

changed_reading.before: The field is an object lesson observed after revelation has been discussed elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, routed water makes the earth enact a delivered, legible communication whose crop is its manifest effect and whose proper reading is insight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the seed-covering branch is activated from a context occurrence whose surface role is disbelief, and hidden roots are not mentioned in the focus. It remains anchored in bringing growth out of concealment, cultivation, and the demand for insight, with multiple context branches organizing hidden-to-visible disclosure. Render it as a heuristic model of latent potential beneath a dry surface, not as a claim that an unmentioned seed or a specific botanical process is asserted.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Growth is brought out through water from land whose visible surface appears cut off from vegetation.

activation_trace.role: Extraction from hiding supplies the focus's explicit disclosure operation.
Cultivated growth supplies the latent life that becomes manifest.
Insight supplies the requested inference from visible emergence to an unseen enabling depth.
Hidden tree roots supply a concrete subterranean store that sight does not initially register.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies the visible pole reached after emergence.
Covering seed with earth supplies the branch-distant mechanism by which potential can disappear beneath a surface.
Removal of concealment supplies the transition from stored potential to disclosed result.

changed_reading.before: Water acts on an apparently lifeless surface and causes new growth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, water discloses latent capacity beneath that surface, training sight to infer hidden enabling structures from what emerges.

strongest_changes: The local field became the ground-level leg of an administered heaven-to-earth delivery rather than a generic rain image.
The depleted-earth-to-emergence sequence became a recurrent material analogue for return after disappearance in earth.
The paired hearing and seeing verses made the focus a second evidence channel, while delayed certainty made present perception time-sensitive.
The adjacent opening language recast present irrigation and insight as useful openings before the final opening no longer benefits or delays.
Provision no longer ended at consumption; it could continue through recipients who send part of what they received outward.
summary.what_was_special: The most distinctive activations came from branch intersections rather than topic matching: corrective return met returning water, gratitude met shoot emergence, successful crop emergence met blocked attempted exit, and reproductive senses converged across water, sterility, sowing, visibility, and birth. A non-dominant mapped target of the opening perception root also made water carriage echo the process being observed.
remaining_uncertainties: The resurrection model may be a process analogy, a more general argument from originating power, or both without full identification.
The reproductive, textual-delivery, hidden-seed, gratitude-growth, and corrective-return readings are branch-distant enough that downstream prose should preserve their exploratory qualification.
The 32:26 to 32:27 pairing is rhetorically strong, but hearing may mean heeding rather than marking a distinct historical evidence medium.
The circulation from nourishment to expenditure is contextually coherent, but the focus verse itself does not state the outward social step.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Life begins with directed delivery to the point of lack.** `س و ق:B001` is driving or impelling something forward; `ج ر ز:B002` is ground stripped of growth or cut off from rain. The construction *nasūqu al-māʾa ilā al-arḍi al-juruz* gives agent, moved resource, and exact destination. **Packet arrow:** water is driven -> barren land receives it. **Inferred arrow:** lack is answered by targeted conveyance, so renewal depends on governed arrival rather than the barren ground producing its own remedy.

2. **Barren is a state that can be crossed, not an essence that fixes the land.** `ج ر ز:B001` supplies cutting off and uprooting beneath the specialized barren-ground branch `ج ر ز:B002`; `خ ر ج:B002` is causing something to emerge, and `ز ر ع:B001` growing crops. The causal *fa-* and instrumental *bihi* explicitly connect water to emergence. **Packet arrow:** water reaches cut-off ground -> by it crop is brought out. **Inferred change:** an apparently closed surface contains recoverable generativity when the missing input arrives.

3. **The output enters a shared dependency chain.** `ء ك ل:B001` is ingesting food and `ن ع م:B005` identifies grazing livestock. The single crop is followed by two coordinated consumers, “their livestock and their selves.” **Inferred arrow:** one revived field -> animal nourishment + human nourishment -> life propagated across dependent levels. The scene makes provision systemic rather than private.

4. **Sight must move from observation to self-witness.** The ayah begins with a seeing question and ends with `ب ص ر:B001`, bodily sight, while `ب ص ر:B002` also permits inner sight and self-witness. **Reading A:** the recurring water-to-crop process is directly inspectable. **Reading B:** inspection should disclose a wider pattern of emergence from apparent lifelessness. The branch pair supports the **inferred arrow:** seen renewal -> inward recognition of recoverable life; the final rebuke marks failure between those stages.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 32:28 immediately followed visible emergence from barren land with “when is this opening?” That juxtaposition sharpened the failed sight in 32:27: the problem is not inability to observe opening-like renewal but fixation on a terminal event whose arrival, 32:29 reveals, ends useful response.

baseline.text: Suyu kurak toprağa sürdüğümüzü ve onunla, hayvanlarının da kendilerinin de yediği ekin çıkardığımızı görmediler mi? Hâlâ görmüyorlar mı?

findings.text: Hayat, eksikliğin bulunduğu yere suyun özellikle sürülmesiyle başlar; kurak yer kendi çözümünü üretmez, yönetilmiş bir ulaştırmayla yenilenir.
Kuraklık toprağın değişmez özü değil, gerekli girdi geldiğinde aşılanabilen bir kesilmişlik durumudur; kapalı görünen yüzey yeniden ürün çıkarabilir.
Ayetin başındaki görme ile sonundaki basiret çağrısı, gözlenen yenilenmeden görünmez olmuş hayatın geri çıkarılabileceğine dair iç tanıklığa geçiş ister.
Suyun toprağa girip ürün çıkarması, üreme sıvısının bedende soy üretmesiyle büyük ölçekte bir yaratılış benzerliği kurabilir.

inter_ayah_rows.note: It closely parallels water sent into the earth and producing varied crops, extending the focus's directed renewal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its repeated blindness supplies a limited counterpart to the focus's final call for insight.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The reduction of land offers only a distant counterpoint to the focus's restoration of barren ground.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It establishes earth as prepared for living creatures, a background for the focus's revived ground and provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Water is made the basis of all living things and the same observational challenge is pressed on deniers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Human creation from clay does not develop the focus's water, crop, or perception sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Created livestock under human use helps illuminate the focus's crop as food for herds as well as people.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins made-habitable earth, descending water, and vegetation brought forth in a close parallel sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rain sent down and made drinkable shows water as a divinely directed life-giving provision, without the barren-land scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its appeal to recognize a visible divine favor only broadly resembles the focus's appeal to see.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Leadership, patience, and certainty do not clarify the ecological sign in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its barren ground is the explicit opposite state from which the focus's driven water draws a crop.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It asks people to look at the earth's abundant noble growth, directly reinforcing the focus's evidentiary vegetation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Human eating and livestock grazing directly echo the two recipients of the focus's crop.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Bringing a people from darkness to light is a distinct metaphorical movement, not the focus's material renewal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It traces descending water through vegetation and grain, closely expanding the focus's crop brought forth by water.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Seeing people ally with disbelievers does not illuminate the focus's ecological or perceptual sign.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The emphatic pouring of water supplies the incoming provision that the focus depicts as driven to the land.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: One water irrigates adjoining lands and yields differentiated crops and food, closely clarifying productive water.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its failed attempt to come out of the Fire is only a remote contrast to beneficial bringing forth.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Abundantly poured water supports the focus's portrayal of water as a supplied life-giving input.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Day made seeing offers a general condition of visibility, but not the focus's sign of renewed land.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Land becomes a legible sign through opposed processes: prior movement has ended in stilled dwellings, while driven water restarts growth and distributes life.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Historical absence is heard through inhabited space, while water is herded through a severed landscape until the ground yields food and living selves.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hydraulic reactivation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water is driven in sequence into land stripped of growth, where it extracts a crop from concealment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: visual observation (quranic:root_000531:B001/m01); driving or herding (quranic:root_000762:B001/m01); following in one sequence (quranic:root_000762:B012/m01); water as material (quranic:root_001458:B001/m01); water appearing and increasing (quranic:root_001458:B002/m01); irrigation by pouring (quranic:root_001458:B003/m01); fertile ground (quranic:root_000025:B002/m01); severance (quranic:root_000236:B001/m01); land stripped of growth (quranic:root_000236:B002/m01); emergence from an enclosure (quranic:root_000400:B001/m01); extraction from concealment (quranic:root_000400:B002/m01); sowing and plant growth (quranic:root_000630:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 32:27 `يروا` (ر ء ي), `نسوق` (س و ق), `الماء` (م و ه), `الأرض` (ء ر ض), `الجرز` (ج ر ز), `نخرج` (خ ر ج), `زرعا` (ز ر ع)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The water does not merely arrive; it is herded along a controlled route. The ground's barrenness is a severance, and irrigation repairs the process by making hidden growth emerge as crop.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
Bir şeyi gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan ve tanık olarak görme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, gözle görmeyi temel alır ve bazı anlatımlarda bu algıyı içsel kavrayışa kadar genişletir; doğrudan göz tanıklığı özellikle belirtilir.
